body.p:
When editing in a Content Fusion project, the AI Positron view is accessible from the left navigation menu. Also, AI actions that save content or add references to DITA maps (e.g. the actions in the Intelligent Agents category) present some additional user actions (they are presented as buttons):
Rollback changes - You can revert all changes made after a checkpoint by clicking the Rollback action to the right of the particular checkpoint.
Open File - You can click on the button that contains the file name to open it in the visual editor.
Inspect changes - You can click the diff button to review the modifications made by the AI in the built-in comparison tool.
